items.q: On which day of a typical 28-day menstrual cycle does ovulation usually occur?
items.qAf: Op watter dag van ’n tipiese 28-dae menstruasiesiklus vind ovulasie gewoonlik plaas?
items.explain: Ovulation occurs around day 14, midway through the cycle.
items.explainAf: Ovulasie vind ongeveer op dag 14 plaas, halfpad deur die siklus.

items.explain: A surge of luteinising hormone (LH) triggers the release of the ovum.
items.explainAf: ’n Skielike toename in luteïniserende hormoon (LH) veroorsaak die vrystelling van die eiersel.

items.q: Progesterone secreted by the corpus luteum mainly maintains:
items.qAf: Progesteroon wat deur die geelliggaam afgeskei word, handhaaf hoofsaaklik:
items.explain: Progesterone keeps the endometrium thick and ready for a possible pregnancy.
items.explainAf: Progesteroon hou die endometrium dik en gereed vir ’n moontlike swangerskap.

items.q: A tubal ligation prevents pregnancy by:
options: Blocking the oviducts so the ovum cannot meet the sperm
optionsAf: Blocking the oviducts so the ovum cannot meet the sperm
items.explain: Cutting or blocking the oviducts stops sperm reaching the ovum.
items.explainAf: Die snyding of blokkering van die eierleiers verhoed dat sperm die eiersel bereik.

items.q: Which contraceptive method also protects against sexually transmitted infections?
items.qAf: Watter anti-konsepsiemetode beskerm ook teen seksueel oordraagbare infeksies?
items.explain: A condom forms a physical barrier, which hormonal methods and sterilisation do not provide.
items.explainAf: ’n Kondoom vorm ’n fisiese versperring, wat hormonale metodes en sterilisasie nie bied nie.

items.q: Hormonal contraceptives mainly prevent pregnancy by:
items.qAf: Hormonale anti-konsepsiemiddels verhoed swangerskap hoofsaaklik deur:
options: Blocking the uterus with a device
optionsAf: Blocking the uterus with a device
items.explain: The hormones suppress FSH and LH so that no ovum is released.
items.explainAf: Die hormone onderdruk FSH en LH sodat geen eiersel vrygestel word nie.

items.q: The release of an ovum from the ovary.
items.qAf: Die vrystelling van ’n eiersel uit die eierstok.

items.q: The structure that forms from the empty follicle after ovulation and secretes progesterone.
items.qAf: Die struktuur wat ná ovulasie uit die leë follikel vorm en progesteroon afskei.

items.q: The membrane that surrounds the foetus and contains fluid that protects it.
items.qAf: Die membraan wat die fetus omring en vloeistof bevat wat dit beskerm.

items.q: The hormone that stimulates the development of a follicle in the ovary.
items.qAf: Die hormoon wat die ontwikkeling van ’n follikel in die eierstok stimuleer.

items.text: A surge of [[]] causes ovulation. [[]] maintains the thickened endometrium during pregnancy.
items.textAf: ’n Skielike styging van [[]] veroorsaak ovulasie. [[]] handhaaf die verdikte endometrium tydens swangerskap.

items.q: Fertilisation normally takes place in the Fallopian tube.
items.qAf: Bevrugting vind normaalweg in die Fallopiusbuis plaas.
items.explain: True. The zygote then moves to the uterus, where it implants.
items.explainAf: Waar. Die sigoot beweeg dan na die baarmoeder, waar dit innestel.

items.q: The blood of the mother and the foetus mixes in the placenta.
items.qAf: Die bloed van die moeder en die fetus meng in die plasenta.
items.explain: False. They are separated by thin membranes; substances diffuse across.
items.explainAf: Onwaar. Hulle word deur dun membrane geskei; stowwe diffundeer daaroor.

items.q: Put the events in order, starting with ovulation.
items.qAf: Rangskik die gebeure in volgorde, begin by ovulasie.
steps: Zygote divides to form a blastocyst
stepsAf: Sigoot deel om ’n blastosist te vorm

items.q: Explain why menstruation does not take place during pregnancy.
items.qAf: Verduidelik waarom menstruasie nie tydens swangerskap plaasvind nie.
points: The corpus luteum (and later the placenta) keeps secreting progesterone.
Progesterone keeps the endometrium thick and inhibits FSH, so no new follicles develop.
pointsAf: Die corpus luteum (en later die plasenta) hou aan om progesteroon af te skei.
Progesteroon hou die endometrium dik en inhibeer FSH, dus ontwikkel geen nuwe follikels nie.
